career_ladder.note: Recruits join the Indian Army under the Agnipath Scheme as Agniveers for a fixed 4-year engagement period. Upon completion of 4 years, up to 25% of each Agniveer batch are selected for enrolment into the regular cadre of the Indian Army as Sepoy / Rifleman / Gunner / Sowar based on centralized merit and performance during service. Those absorbed into the regular cadre follow the permanent Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) and Other Ranks (OR) promotional ladder.

exam_scheme.note: Indian Army Agniveer recruitment is conducted through a two-phase selection procedure: Phase I is an All India Online Computer Based Common Entrance Exam (CEE) administered across designated test centres; Phase II comprises the Recruitment Rally conducted by designated Zonal Recruiting Offices (ZRO) / Army Recruiting Offices (ARO), which includes Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Adaptability Test, and Detailed Medical Examination.

stages.stage_name: Phase I: Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE) Computer Based Test
stages.source_label: Indian Army — Scheme of Online Common Entrance Exam for Agniveer Recruitment

papers.paper_name: Agniveer General Duty (GD): General Knowledge (15 Qs, 30m), General Science (15 Qs, 30m), Maths (15 Qs, 30m), Logical Reasoning (5 Qs, 10m)
Agniveer Technical: General Knowledge & Reasoning (10 Qs, 40m), Maths (15 Qs, 60m), Physics (15 Qs, 60m), Chemistry (10 Qs, 40m)
Agniveer Clerk / Store Keeper Technical: Part 1 GK, Science, Maths, Computer (25 Qs, 100m) and Part 2 General English (25 Qs, 100m)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 80 marks minimum passing (min 32 marks in each part)

papers.paper_name: Physical Fitness Test (PFT): 1.6 Km Run (Group I: 60 marks, Group II: 48 marks), Beam / Pull-ups (up to 40 marks), 9 Feet Ditch, Zig-Zag Balance
papers.qualifying_threshold: Scored for Agniveer GD/Tradesman; qualifying for Tech/Clerk

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Adaptability Test: Height, Chest, Weight measurements and psychological psychometric test
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying standard as per regional physical categories

papers.paper_name: Detailed Medical Examination: Clinical and surgical examination by Military Medical Officers at rally site / Military Hospital
papers.qualifying_threshold: Fit in all military medical categories

financial_package.note: Under the Agnipath Scheme, Agniveers receive a customized monthly package starting at ₹30,000 in the 1st year and progressing to ₹40,000 in the 4th year, with 30% contributed to the Agniveer Corpus Fund matched equally by the Government of India. Upon discharge after 4 years, non-retained personnel receive the accumulated Seva Nidhi package (~₹10.04 Lakhs + interest, approx. ₹11.71 Lakhs tax-free). Personnel absorbed into the regular cadre enter Defence Pay Matrix Level 3 (₹21,700 – ₹69,100) plus Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹5,200 per month and standard central dearness allowance.
financial_package.pay_level: Agnipath Customised Package (1st–4th Year) / Level 3 on regular absorption
financial_package.pay_source_label: Ministry of Defence — Official Agnipath Scheme Notification and Emoluments Schedule
financial_package.estimate_note: During the 4-year Agniveer tenure: Year 1 monthly pay is ₹30,000 (in-hand ₹21,000 + ₹9,000 corpus contribution); Year 2 is ₹33,000 (in-hand ₹23,100); Year 3 is ₹36,500 (in-hand ₹25,550); Year 4 is ₹40,000 (in-hand ₹28,000). Seva Nidhi corpus on exit after 4 years is ~₹10.04 Lakhs plus interest (total ~₹11.71 Lakhs tax-free). Personnel selected for permanent retention receive regular Level 3 pay (₹21,700 basic + ₹5,200 MSP + 58% DA + allowances).
official_perks: Seva Nidhi package of ~₹11.71 Lakhs (accumulated corpus + matching GOI contribution + accrued interest) fully exempt from Income Tax on completion of 4-year tenure
Non-contributory Life Insurance Cover of ₹48,00,000 for the entire 4-year engagement period
Ex-gratia compensation of ₹44,00,000 to next-of-kin in case of death attributable to service, plus unserved portion of balance tenure pay
Full medical facilities at Service Hospitals and CSD canteen access during engagement
Skill certificate and 10% reservation in Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs), Assam Rifles, and state police forces on demobilisation
Risk and Hardship Allowance, Uniform Allowance, and Ration Allowance as applicable to regular soldiers across field and high-altitude deployments

competition_benchmarks.note: Recruitment under the Agnipath Scheme is conducted across all ZROs/AROs nationwide with multi-lakh applicant participation.
